question: If 3 of 5÷2+(3x)/(1+frac{12){2+(2x)/(1-x)}}=12(1)/(2), what is the value of x?
solution:
**Concept Used:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3e7b7f76096e8704b19f5e673c02b6bd9c84a899232b434aebee79684d366cfc.png] 

**Calculation:**

3 of 5÷2+(3x)/(1+frac{12){2+(2x)/(1-x)}}=12(1)/(2)

⇒ 15 over 2 + (3x)/(1+frac{12){2 - 2x + 2x over1-x}} = 25 over2

⇒ (3x)/(1+frac{12){2 over1-x}} = 25 over2 - 15 over 2

⇒ (3x)/(1+{6over{1over 1 - x)}} = 5

⇒ 3x over {1 + 6 - 6x} = 5

⇒ 3x over 7 - 6x = 5

⇒ 3x = 35 - 30x

⇒ 33x = 35

⇒ x = 35/33

**∴ The value of x is 35/33.**
